mcpConfirmation.title: Confirm client action
mcpConfirmation.intro: Review the action requested by your MCP client. Approval is valid once, until the deadline. Return to your client to continue; this page does not execute the action.
mcpConfirmation.privacy: Details may contain private information. Reveal them only in a private setting. These details are read-only.
mcpConfirmation.passwordHint: Use the local password for the current account. It is cleared when submitted or when you leave this page.
mcpConfirmation.approved: Approved. Return to your MCP client to continue before expiry. This approval can be used only once.
mcpConfirmation.expired: This confirmation has expired. Request a new action from your client.
mcpConfirmation.invalid: This confirmation is invalid or unavailable. It may have expired, been used, or belong to a different account or tenant. Check the account and request a new confirmation from your client.
mcpConfirmation.unsupported: This confirmation cannot be approved here. A local account password is required.
mcpConfirmation.failed: Could not load the confirmation. Check your connection and try again.
mcpConfirmation.approveFailed: Approval failed or its result could not be verified. Check your local password and reload the confirmation before trying again.
mcpConfirmation.passwordFailed: Password verification failed or your session has expired. Check the current account's local password. If your session has expired, sign in again and reopen this confirmation.
mcpConfirmation.locked: Password verification is temporarily locked after too many failed attempts. Wait before trying again; request a new confirmation if this one expires.
mcpConfirmation.changed: The confirmation changed or is no longer pending. Reload it and review the action again.

setup.defaultsNote: Review the configuration above. Passwords and keys are hidden from this summary. Unchanged optional settings use defaults.
setup.tokenHint: For remote access, enter the setup token printed in the server startup console. Leave blank for a direct local connection. The token stays only in this page's memory and must be entered again after a refresh.
setup.streamIncomplete: The complete setup result was not received. Check the server status. Refresh if setup has completed; otherwise confirm the state before retrying.
setup.restartRequired: Setup completed, but switching to normal mode failed. Restart the server before signing in.

probe.tokenRequired: These checks require the setup token even locally. Enter the token from the server console in the setup token field above.
probe.s3Scope: Sends a signed HEAD request to the target bucket only. Does not create buckets, list objects or read/write objects; object permissions and prefix access remain unchecked.
probe.aiScope: Only calls GET /models with the configured credentials and checks whether the selected model is listed. Sends no generation request. A public models endpoint does not prove key validity or generation access.
probe.s3Ok: Bucket HEAD check passed. Object read/write permissions are not verified.
probe.aiOk: Models endpoint responded and the selected model is listed. Generation and its authorization are not verified.
probe.invalid: Check the endpoint, required fields and credentials.
probe.connection: Could not connect. Check address, network and TLS configuration.
probe.denied: The endpoint denied authentication or access.
probe.notFound: The bucket or models endpoint was not found.
probe.redirect: Redirect refused. Configure the final endpoint directly.
probe.upstreamLimited: The upstream service rate limited this check.
probe.upstream: The upstream service could not complete the check.
probe.invalidResponse: The endpoint did not return a valid OpenAI-compatible models list.
probe.modelNotListed: Models endpoint responded, but the selected model was not listed. Generation remains unverified.
probe.requestFailed: The check request failed. Check the setup token, setup state and network, or wait before retrying.
probe.rateLimited: Checks are limited. Wait briefly before retrying.
